mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (current level below 0.5%) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns, as lower rates reduce the discount rate for equity valuations and increase the attractiveness of equities relative to bonds.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 5.5% signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When both housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) show month-over-month growth, the combined signal indicates robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days through increased corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: The joint growth of HOUST and RSAFS does not produce positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both series show positive MoM growth.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL annualized inflation > 3%), a month-over-month increase in the consumer price index signals the central bank may tighten policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: In periods when CPIAUCSL annualized inflation exceeds 3%, the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of industrial production (INDPRO above 105) signals robust economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days as corporate earnings are expected to rise.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 105.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level above 1100.0 thousand units signals strong residential construction, which is a leading indicator of economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1100.0.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.5%), a month-over-month decline in the unemployment rate signals improving labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: In periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.5%, the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases when UNRATE declines month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month increase in the consumer price index above 0.3% signals rising inflation, which may prompt central bank tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL MoM change exceeds 0.3%.
